crossRefs.note: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.
But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…

parallels.note: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd, and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”
translations.bsb: At once Jesus was aware that power had gone out from Him. Turning to the crowd, He asked, “Who touched My garments?”
translations.kjv: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
translations.asv: And straightway Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power proceeding from him had gone forth, turned him about in the crowd, and said, Who touched my garments?
